scope: Analytic support proof and CPU f64 camera/slab/planar recurrence only; not native WGSL field or GPU replay

front_all.proof: All three branches clipped at x=+-3,y=0..3.4. Envelope >.065 early return makes abs(z)>.18+.065 strictly positive.

floor.proof: Original box, final displacement only under abs(selected base d)<.012.

side.proof: Analytic id1 box; no final distance displacement.

rear.proof: Analytic id1 box; no final distance displacement.

door_frame.proof: CSG max(outer,-inner) subset of outer; final id3 displacement activation shell .012.

window_frame.proof: CSG max(outer,-inner) subset of outer; final id5 displacement activation shell .012.

glass.proof: Analytic id6 box; no final displacement.

rail_posts.proof: x is clamped to the finite segment; capsule radius .018 and final id5 activation .012.

rail_horizontal.proof: Finite capsule endpoints, radius .027 and final id5 activation .012.

cable.proof: tx clamped +-2.8, parabola cy in [2.93,3.03]; radius .013 and id7 activation .012.

bed.proof: Analytic box with final id4 activation .012, independent of mother height amplitude.

bed_legs.proof: Union of four leg boxes, final id4 activation .012.

cloth_rail.proof: Finite capsule radius .018 and final id5 activation .012.

cloth.proof: Fold abs(sheet)<=.045+.018=.063. Base box is tighter; native branch uses max(native,box(q,[.46,.67,.02])). No later displacement.

limits: 50 micrometres is query padding, not geometry displacement.
10 micrometres beyond the maximum hit epsilon is a chosen numerical margin, not a general formal f32 error proof. GPU replay is still required.
Plane recurrence assumes the upper plane controls the distance. It diagnoses convergence; it does not predict final native hit identity for every candidate.
